$schema: Coqui source map — describes every core source file so the agent can understand its own codebase.

layers.agent: Agent classes — the orchestrator and child agent implementations
layers.command: Symfony Console commands — CLI entry points and REPL loop
layers.config: Configuration, safety, and discovery — workspace management, credential resolution, toolkit discovery
layers.contract: Interfaces and value objects — the contracts that define extensibility points
layers.tool: Tools — individual capabilities the agent can invoke during conversation
layers.toolkit: Toolkits — groups of related tools with shared guidelines
layers.observer: Observers — real-time event rendering for terminal output
layers.storage: Storage — SQLite-backed session and audit persistence

files.description: Top-level orchestrator agent. Extends AbstractAgent. Registers all toolkits (FilesystemToolkit, ShellToolkit, MemoryToolkit, ProjectSourceToolkit, ToolkitGeneratorToolkit, auto-discovered toolkits) and all standalone tools (spawn_agent, composer, credentials, package_info, packagist, php_execute, restart_coqui). Contains the master system prompt in instructions(). Constructed fresh on every REPL turn.
methods: instructions(): string — returns the full system prompt with role descriptions, security rules, and operational guidelines
tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns standalone tools (spawn, composer, credentials, package_info, packagist, php_execute, restart_coqui)
requiredCapabilities(): ModelCapability[] — Text + Tools
getSpawnTool(): SpawnAgentTool — accessor for iteration tracking

files.description: Flexible child agent spawned by SpawnAgentTool. Receives role, task instructions, and toolkits at construction time. Has role-specific instructions for 'coder' (PHP expert), 'reviewer' (code analyst), and a generic default.
methods: instructions(): string — role-specific system prompt (coder/reviewer/default) + task injection
requiredCapabilities(): ModelCapability[] — Text + Tools
getRole(): string — returns the agent's role

files.description: Handles agent creation, execution, and turn message persistence. Manages the full turn lifecycle: creates a turn record before execution, tracks timing, extracts tool usage and child agent counts, and completes the turn with all metadata after execution. Passes turnId through to execution policies and message persistence for full traceability.
methods: run(string $prompt, string $sessionId, SymfonyStyle $io): bool — runs a single agent turn with turn lifecycle tracking; returns true if restart requested
createAgent(...): OrchestratorAgent — builds the orchestrator agent with all dependencies
buildExecutionPolicy(string $sessionId, SymfonyStyle $io, ?string $turnId): ToolExecutionPolicyInterface — creates approval policy with turnId forwarding
persistTurnMessages(Conversation, int, string, ?string $turnId): void — persists new messages from a turn with turn linkage
extractToolsUsed(?Conversation): string[] — extracts unique tool names from conversation tool calls

files.description: Main Symfony Console command ('run'). Boots the entire system: loads config, resolves workspace, initializes WorkspaceComposerManager, ToolkitDiscovery, SessionStorage, then runs the REPL loop. Handles CLI flags --unsafe, --auto-approve, --config, --new, --session, --workdir. Contains gated tools definition, approval policy construction, and restart logic (RESTART_EXIT_CODE = 10, restartRequested flag).
methods: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — main entry point; boots system and enters REPL loop
handleCommand(string, SymfonyStyle): int|true — processes REPL commands (/new, /history, /sessions, /resume, /model, /help, /restart, /quit); returns exit code or true to continue
runAgent(string, SymfonyStyle): void — creates OrchestratorAgent with restart callback, runs agent turn, checks restartRequested flag

files.description: Standalone 'setup' command that runs the SetupWizard to create or overwrite openclaw.json.
methods: execute(InputInterface, OutputInterface): int — runs the interactive setup wizard

files.description: ToolExecutionPolicyInterface implementation. Auto-approves all tool executions except catastrophic blacklist matches. Used when --auto-approve CLI flag is passed. All decisions are logged to the audit_log table with turn_id linkage.
methods: shouldExecute(string $toolName, array $arguments): true|string — returns true to allow, or denial reason string. Forwards turnId to logAudit.

files.description: Hardcoded regex patterns for destructive commands (rm -rf /, shutdown, fork bombs, dd, curl | bash, etc.) that can NEVER be bypassed. Also supports user additions via agents.defaults.blacklist in openclaw.json.
methods: isBlocked(string $command): bool — checks command against all patterns
getMatchedPattern(string $command): ?string — returns the matched pattern or null

files.description: CredentialResolverInterface implementation. Reads/writes workspace .env file. No caching — re-reads on every get() for hot-reload. set() calls putenv() for immediate availability. File permissions set to 0600.
methods: get(string $key): ?string — reads credential from .env, returns null if missing
has(string $key): bool — checks if credential exists
set(string $key, string $value): void — writes to .env AND calls putenv()
delete(string $key): void — removes from .env and unsets env var
loadIntoProcessEnv(): void — loads all .env values into process environment
keys(): string[] — returns all stored key names
envPath(): string — returns the .env file path

files.description: Loads and provides typed access to config/defaults.json. Centralizes all hardcoded defaults (providers, models, base URLs, roles) into a single editable JSON file shipped with the package.
methods: providerNames(): string[] — all provider keys (ollama, openai, anthropic, openrouter)
provider(string $name): array — full provider config block
providers(): array — all providers and their configurations
defaultBaseUrl(string $provider): string — default API base URL
requiresApiKey(string $provider): bool — whether the provider needs an API key
curatedModels(string $provider): array — list of recommended models
roleDefinitions(): array — all role definitions with descriptions
defaultModel(): string — default model string (provider/model)
defaultWorkspace(): string — default workspace directory path

files.description: ToolExecutionPolicyInterface implementation. Prompts user for confirmation on gated tools. Catastrophic blacklist checked first (no prompt — just blocked). Gated tools configured via $gatedTools map (tool name → action list or ['*']). Forwards turnId to logAudit.
methods: shouldExecute(string $toolName, array $arguments): true|string — prompts user, returns true to allow or denial reason. Forwards turnId to logAudit.

files.description: Maps role names (orchestrator, coder, reviewer) to provider/model strings from openclaw.json. Falls back to primary model when a role is undefined.
methods: resolve(string $role): string — returns provider/model string for the given role
availableRoles(): string[] — returns all configured role names

files.description: Static analysis of generated PHP code. Blocks dangerous functions (eval, exec, system, passthru, shell_exec, proc_open, etc.) and filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, fopen, mkdir, unlink, rename, copy, etc.) to prevent writes to the project root. Also blocks patterns (backtick execution, privilege escalation, pipe to shell). In --unsafe mode, only catastrophic patterns are enforced.
methods: validate(string $code): string[] — returns array of issue descriptions (empty means safe)
isUnsafe(): bool — whether running in unsafe mode

files.description: Interactive wizard for building openclaw.json. Steps: select providers → configure each (base URL, API key, model discovery) → assign roles → set primary model → configure workspace. Supports live model discovery via Ollama/OpenAI APIs.
methods: run(): array — runs the interactive wizard, returns the generated config array

files.description: Discovers ToolkitInterface implementations from installed Composer packages. Checks extra.php-agents.toolkits in package composer.json. Persists discovered toolkits in toolkits.json registry. Scans both project and workspace vendor directories. Wraps toolkits with CredentialGuardToolkit when credential requirements are declared.
methods: discover(string $packageName): string[] — scan a single package for toolkit classes
discoverAll(): array — scan all installed packages (project + workspace)
instantiateRegistered(): ToolkitInterface[] — instantiate all registered toolkit classes
register(string $packageName, string[] $classNames): void — persist toolkit registry
unregister(string $packageName): void — remove from registry
loadCredentialRequirements(string $packageName): CredentialRequirement[] — load credential declarations

files.description: Manages a separate Composer project inside the workspace directory (.workspace/composer.json). The workspace has its own vendor/ so the bot can self-install packages without touching the user's main project.
methods: initialize(): void — creates scaffold composer.json if missing
loadAutoloader(): bool — loads workspace vendor/autoload.php
isInitialized(): bool — checks if composer.json exists
composerJsonPath(): string — path to workspace composer.json
workspacePath(): string — workspace root path

files.description: Resolves the workspace directory from openclaw.json config. Supports relative paths (resolved against project root), absolute paths, and ~ expansion. Default: .workspace. Creates directory and .gitkeep if missing.
methods: resolve(): string — returns the absolute workspace path

files.description: Final readonly value object representing a credential requirement: name (env var name) + description (human-readable). Used by the CredentialGuard system to declare what keys a toolkit needs.
Interface for credential management with hot-reload support. Implementations must persist to .env and call putenv() on set() for immediate availability without restart.
methods: get(string $key): ?string
has(string $key): bool
set(string $key, string $value): void
delete(string $key): void
loadIntoProcessEnv(): void
keys(): string[]
envPath(): string

files.description: Manages Composer dependencies in the workspace only. Actions: require, remove, show, installed, update, validate, outdated, audit. Has a denylist blocking full frameworks. Auto-creates backups before mutations. Triggers toolkit discovery after install. Cannot target the project root — workspace-only for security.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to action handler based on 'action' parameter

files.description: ToolInterface decorator that intercepts execute() and checks if required credentials exist. Returns structured error with exact key names and credentials tool call syntax when missing. The inner tool is never invoked when credentials are missing.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — checks credentials, delegates to inner tool if all present

files.description: ToolkitInterface decorator that wraps all inner toolkit tools with CredentialGuardTool. Appends credential status (configured/MISSING) to the guidelines string.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns wrapped tools
guidelines(): string — inner guidelines + credential status appendix

files.description: LLM-facing CRUD tool for credentials. Actions: set, get, list, delete. Values are never returned to the LLM after storing. Key names must be UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. Delegates to CredentialResolverInterface.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to set/get/list/delete handlers

files.description: Introspects installed Composer packages on-demand. Actions: readme (8KB truncated), classes (reflection-based listing), methods (deep inspect with param/return types), source (read file, 12KB truncated). Lets the agent learn how to use an SDK without pre-injecting documentation.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to readme/classes/methods/source handlers

files.description: Queries Packagist.org API. Actions: search, popular, details, stats, versions, advisories. Uses HttpClientInterface. All anonymous endpoints. Used to discover and evaluate packages before installing.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — dispatches to search/popular/details/stats/versions/advisories

files.description: Executes generated PHP code in a sandboxed subprocess. cwd is workspace, open_basedir restricts filesystem access. ScriptSanitizer blocks filesystem write functions (file_put_contents, fwrite, mkdir, unlink, etc.) at the static analysis level before code runs, preventing writes to the project root. Auto-prepends bootstrap preamble (strict_types, project + workspace autoloaders, .env loader). Output truncated to 32KB. Security: ScriptSanitizer (static check) + open_basedir (runtime restriction) + InteractiveApprovalPolicy (user confirmation) + timeout.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — sanitizes code, writes to temp file, runs via proc_open

files.description: Agent-facing tool that triggers a graceful restart of Coqui. Sets a restartRequested flag on RunCommand via a closure callback. After the current agent turn completes, the REPL loop checks the flag and exits with RESTART_EXIT_CODE (10). The launcher script detects this exit code and relaunches the process. Gated by execution policy — requires user confirmation unless --auto-approve is enabled.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — sets restart flag via closure, returns success message with reason

files.description: Spawns child agents with role-specific models and toolkits. Creates a ChildAgent, attaches observer, runs it with the task prompt, and returns the result. Logs child runs to SessionStorage. Tracks child run count per turn. The orchestrator uses this to delegate work to Claude (coder), GPT-4 (reviewer), etc.
methods: execute(array $input): ToolResult — resolves role to model, builds toolkits, runs child agent
buildToolkits(string $role): ToolkitInterface[] — returns role-specific toolkit set
setCurrentIteration(int $iteration): void — tracks parent iteration for logging
getChildRunCount(): int — returns number of child agents spawned during this turn

files.description: Read-only toolkit providing structured access to the Coqui project source code. Tools: project_source_map (returns config/source.json), project_read (reads a file from project root), project_list (lists a directory), project_search (glob search). Enables the agent to understand and navigate its own codebase.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns project_source_map, project_read, project_list, project_search
guidelines(): string — usage instructions for project source access

files.description: Generates complete toolkit package scaffolds for Coqui. Tools: toolkit_create (scaffolds a new package with composer.json, toolkit class, README, runs composer install), toolkit_add_tool (inserts a new tool into an existing toolkit class), toolkit_list (lists workspace toolkit packages with metadata). All generated packages follow Coqui conventions and are auto-discoverable.
methods: tools(): ToolInterface[] — returns toolkit_create, toolkit_add_tool, toolkit_list
guidelines(): string — usage instructions for toolkit generation workflow

files.description: SplObserver implementation that streams agent events to the terminal. Handles events: agent.start, agent.iteration, agent.tool_call, agent.tool_result, agent.done, agent.error, child.start, child.end. Manages indent level for nested child agent output.
methods: update(SplSubject $subject): void — dispatches agent events to terminal rendering
handleEvent(string $event, mixed $data): void — direct event handling for child spawn notifications

files.description: SQLite-backed session persistence. Tables: sessions, messages, child_runs, audit_log, turns. WAL mode + foreign keys enabled. Supports creating/listing sessions, adding/loading messages (rebuilds Conversation objects), logging child runs, audit logging, token count tracking, and turn lifecycle management (createTurn, completeTurn, getTurns, getTurnWithMessages). Idempotent migrations add turn_id FK columns to messages and audit_log tables.
methods: createSession(string $modelRole, string $model): string — creates new session, returns ID
listSessions(int $limit): array — lists recent sessions
getSession(string $id): ?array — retrieves session details
addMessage(string $sessionId, ..., ?string $turnId): string — persists a message with optional turn linkage
loadConversation(string $sessionId): Conversation — rebuilds full conversation history
logChildRun(...): string — logs a child agent execution
logAudit(..., ?string $turnId): string — logs a tool execution decision with optional turn linkage
getLatestSessionId(): ?string — returns most recent session ID for auto-resume
createTurn(string $sessionId, string $userPrompt, ?string $model): string — creates a turn record, returns ID
completeTurn(string $turnId, ...): void — updates turn with response, tokens, duration, tools used
getTurns(string $sessionId, int $limit): array — returns turns ordered by turn_number ASC
getTurnWithMessages(string $turnId): ?array — returns turn with nested messages

externalDependencies.description: Core library providing agents, toolkits, providers, and the tool-use loop

keyFiles.description: Contract for tools: name(), description(), parameters(), execute(), toFunctionSchema()
Contract for tool groups: tools(), guidelines()
Contract for agents: instructions(), tools(), run()
Base agent with tool-use loop, observer pattern, toolkit registration, system prompt building
Generic Tool implementation — takes name, description, parameters, callback closure
Immutable result from tool execution: success(content) or error(message)
Read/write filesystem tools (read_file, write_file, list_dir, search_files, file_info, create_dir, delete_file). Supports readOnly mode.
Shell command execution with allowedCommands whitelist and built-in safety patterns
Persistent key-value memory (memory_save, memory_load, memory_forget) backed by FileMemory
Creates provider instances from 'provider/model' strings using OpenClaw config
